summary: V1 UX Freeze Phase 2 e2e (web+mobile+backend). Backend 7/7 pytest passed (POST /api/ananta/ask: public 401/403, disabled=false yields 403, empty question 400, 'Pause Hunter' returns strategy_disable action with params.key='hunter'; regressions: ask_ananta_enabled PUT persistence, /api/strategy/{key}/state disable+enable, /api/orders/manual paper BUY/SELL). WEB (owner logged in, ask_ananta_enabled=true, ananta_onboarded=1): cockpit-start-trading opens trading-wizard; wizard-mode-* (2), wizard-strategy-* (11), wizard-method-* (2), wizard-launch closes modal + fires ananta:wizard listener; ask-ananta-chip visible bottom-left, opens ask-ananta-panel, ask-ananta-send returns grounded answer + 1 ananta-action-strategy_disable button for 'Pause Hunter'; bottom-nav-strategies routes to strategy-center; strategy-add-btn opens add-menu with add-menu-import/manual/ai and Import opens the import-modal (Pine/Freqtrade/Jesse/JSON). MOBILE (Expo web preview after login-email-input + SKIP onboarding): cockpit-metric-setups=4, scanned=2000, rejected=1996, qualified=4 (real numbers, no dashes); Start Trading launches the Trading Wizard with 11 wizard-strategy-* and wizard-launch closes; ask-ananta-chip opens the panel, 'Pause Hunter' returns 'Hunter strategy is now **paused**...' + ananta-action-strategy_disable ('Pause Hunter'); Strategy tab shows tip-strategy (dismissed via tip-dismiss-strategy) and no legacy header-import-pill; strategy-add-btn opens sheet with add-menu-import/manual/ai; Workspace header title 'Ananta Setup' + ask-ananta-toggle + ws-copilot present; Trade regression: manual-order-submit, strategy-toggle-hunter, sticky-ai-coach, sticky-add-strategy all present. No parity issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow past 2900 lines; ananta_ask + _parse_ananta_intents (~L734–806) mix routing, intent parsing and copilot glue — consider moving to a dedicated ananta router module.
_parse_ananta_intents matches strategy name/key by substring against the raw question — 'continuation' (a common word) could false-positive; consider word-boundary matching.

AddStrategySheet routes all three menu items (import/manual/ai) to the same /library/import route — Write Strategy and Describe & Build should land on distinct builders (or clearly label the shared destination).

Web tab id is 'strategies' (plural) while route/testID naming elsewhere is singular ('strategy-add-btn', ANANTA_TAB_CONTEXT key 'strategy'). Consider standardising to avoid selector confusion in future test agents.
seed_data_creation: None new. Regression BUY BTC $20 + SELL 50% BTC in PAPER mode as required by iter40 flow. ask_ananta_enabled left =true at end (per review note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web tab id for Strategy Center is 'strategies' (plural) — use [data-testid='bottom-nav-strategies'], not 'bottom-nav-strategy'. Mobile bottom tab testIDs use expo-router route names: tab-index (cockpit), tab-trade, tab-strategy, tab-research, tab-workspace (NOT 'text=Trade' — that collides with 'Avg Trade' analytics label). Ask Ananta test IDs mirror across web/mobile (ask-ananta-chip / -panel / -input / -send / -close / ananta-action-<type>). Global conftest auto-injects owner Bearer into mutating requests — use urllib.request to hit /api/ananta/ask and /api/orders/manual anonymously (bypasses monkeypatch). ask_ananta_enabled is currently TRUE.
